name: match_marker_and_parse_fields
description: Compares a stream of bytes against the text marker DIGITAL PERSUASION and, on a full match, decodes decimal digits and words stored just before the marker into several game variables and clears a counter. If the marker is not found, it jumps to the machine reset vector instead.

name: read_ring_buffer_byte
description: Reads the next byte from a 32-entry ring buffer, advancing and wrapping the read index. When a flag is clear and the byte is the character a, it forces a machine reset.

name: handle_ring_buffer_byte
description: Performs the same ring buffer read as its neighbour, advancing the index with a 32-entry wrap and forcing a machine reset when a flag is clear and the byte is the character a. It is reached through a handler pointer stored in data.

name: store_stack_long_into_state
description: A tiny store routine that copies the 32-bit value passed on the stack into one fixed field of the state record. The code is only a few instructions and looks like a small helper decoded from a gap.

name: force_machine_reset
description: Forces a machine reset by calling the reset routine and then jumping to the reset vector. It returns nothing and is called from one other routine.

name: dispatch_index_or_reset
description: Compares a 16-bit value in the state block against 35. Above that limit it dispatches through a jump-table entry; otherwise it calls a library routine and then performs a machine reset.

name: call_library_then_reset
description: Calls a library entry point through a register-relative pointer, performs a machine reset, and then jumps through an indirect table pointer. It is entered from a single caller and does not return normally.

name: reset_then_jump_indirect
description: Performs a machine reset and then transfers control through an indirect pointer taken from a table. Two callers use it as a shared exit.

name: store_memory_block_addresses
description: Requests a memory block through a library call and stores its base address, the address 8000 bytes past it, and a second block's base and end addresses, along with the differences between them, in global variables.

name: store_memory_block_addresses
description: Entry point into the same body as the previous routine: it requests a memory block through a library call and stores its base address and the derived addresses 8000 bytes apart in global variables.

name: store_memory_block_addresses
description: Alternate entry into the memory block address routine: it requests a block through a library call and records its base and the addresses offset by 8000 bytes in global variables.

name: store_memory_block_addresses
description: Another entry into the same memory block address routine, which calls a library function and stores the base and offset addresses in global variables.

name: store_memory_block_addresses
description: Entry into the shared memory block address routine, which fetches a block through a library call and stores its base and derived addresses in global variables.

name: store_memory_block_addresses
description: Entry into the shared memory block address routine, which fetches a block through a library call and stores its base and derived addresses in global variables.

name: store_memory_block_addresses
description: Entry into the shared memory block address routine, which fetches a block through a library call and stores its base and derived addresses in global variables.

name: open_graphics_library
description: Opens the graphics library by name through the system open call and closes it again when finished. The decompiled body shown is a copy of the memory block address routine, so the library handling is taken from the recovered call list.

name: initialize_state_and_planes
description: Sets starting values in the game state and fills several tables with all-ones sentinels. It builds a table of highest set bit indices and eight shifted mask tables, copies a 4000-word block into four planes, and calls several helpers in sequence.

name: decompress_lzss_stream
description: Unpacks an LZSS-style compressed stream using a 4096-byte sliding window pre-filled with spaces. Flag bits select between literal bytes and back-references, and output stops once the expected length is reached.

name: deinterleave_words_into_planes
description: Walks a list of table entries, storing a value at each entry's offset, then splits a block of four-word groups so that each group's words are written to four planes spaced 4000 words apart. Several helper routines are called to finish.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: A stub that only returns, with no work done. It is reached through a pointer taken from data and has no visible effect.

name: dispatch_visible_object_handlers
description: Walks a linked list of object records, skipping any outside a bounding window or carrying the wrong flag. For each visible record it computes a cell position by dividing its coordinates by a scale and calls a handler chosen through a table lookup.

name: blend_source_into_bitplanes
description: For each source byte, combines the four plane bytes stored 8000 bytes apart with values looked up from a table indexed by source bits, then writes the four bytes back. It advances through the planes with a 40-byte row stride.

name: blend_source_into_bitplanes
description: Alternate entry into the same bitplane merge loop, using the same table lookups, 8000-byte plane spacing and 40-byte row stride.

name: advance_position_accumulators
description: Updates two 32-bit position accumulators by adding a 16-bit delta multiplied by a scale that depends on a mode value, and stores the step constants for that mode. In the first mode it resets the accumulators and stores default constants instead.

name: run_timed_update_loop
description: Repeats a sequence of helper calls while a timer counter advances, waiting for each target tick, and exits once a stored value reaches 124. It sets and clears several state flags around the loop.

name: finish_pending_step_sequence
description: If a pending step counter has reached at least 3, runs a fixed sequence of helper calls, sets and clears two flags, and resets the counter to zero. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: run_fixed_step_sequence
description: Runs the same fixed helper sequence as its neighbour without a counter check: it sets and clears two flags around the calls and then zeroes the pending counter.

name: record_cell_if_in_window
description: Checks whether a record's position lies inside a rectangular window. When it does, it converts the position to cell coordinates by dividing by a scale, stores them with a valid flag, and otherwise leaves the stored position unchanged.

name: run_frame_update_loop
description: Large per-frame routine that processes pending state changes and runs helper steps in a loop. When a pending copy flag is set, it copies a 4000-word block into planes and returns; the record is truncated, so later branches are only partly recovered.

name: copy_record_fields_snapped
description: Copies position and state bytes from one record into another, then adjusts the copied x and y coordinates by the remainder of each against 375, using two supplied offsets.

name: adjust_record_coordinates_modulo
description: Adjusts the x and y coordinates of a record by subtracting the difference between each coordinate's remainder modulo 375 and a supplied offset.

name: clear_text_panel_spaces
description: Fills three rows of a character buffer with space characters at fixed strides, then clears a short run in the following row. It appears to blank a text panel.

name: format_status_text_line
description: Builds a status text line by copying name strings from records into a buffer with separators and fixed label characters. When a selector is negative it writes a fallback label; otherwise it writes a two-digit decimal value taken from a number.

name: store_selector_and_result
description: Stores a 16-bit selector into one state field. When the selector is non-negative, it calls a helper and stores that helper's result in a second field.

name: scan_records_from_index
description: Points a state record at the entry for a given index, sets fixed mode and flag values, then repeatedly calls a helper and advances through records until a terminating flag is found.

name: update_selector_history
description: Stores a new selector value. When it is non-negative and differs from the previous one, it swaps the two so the previous value is kept in a second field; when they match, the second field is set to an all-ones marker.

name: scan_records_with_mode_three
description: Performs the same record scan as its neighbour but with a mode value of 3 and a different flag word, advancing through records until a terminating flag is found.

name: tick_counter_fixed_passes
description: Runs a counted loop in which each pass calls two helpers and advances a 16-bit counter, clamped at 4 and masked to keep its sign bit clear.

name: forward_to_helper
description: A thin wrapper that calls one helper routine and returns, adding no logic of its own.

name: store_byte_into_indexed_table
description: Looks up a 16-bit offset in a table using the low byte of the input, doubled as an index, then stores the supplied byte at that offset from the base register and calls a helper.

name: format_status_text_panel
description: Blanks two rows of a text buffer, then writes a name from a record followed by a colon when a flag allows it, a fixed label, and either a bracketed name or a fallback label with a two-digit value. It is a longer variant of the status line formatter.

name: write_three_digit_decimal
description: Writes a 16-bit value into three character cells as decimal digits, hundreds first. Leading zeros are replaced with a blank marker code, while the final digit is always kept.

name: add_three_digit_decimal
description: Adds the hundreds, tens and units digits of a 16-bit value into three character cells that are first set to the ASCII digit zero, producing a zero-padded three-digit number.

name: write_two_digit_decimal
description: Writes the tens and units digits of a 16-bit value into two character cells as zero-padded ASCII digits.

name: write_four_digit_decimal
description: Writes a 16-bit value as four decimal digit characters, thousands first. Leading zeros become a blank marker code, but the units digit is always kept.

name: copy_planes_and_init_grid
description: Copies four 4000-word planes back into a single block, sets default state values, and builds a grid table of 33 by 7 sequential values with a row step of 320. It then loops calling helpers until a flag ends the loop.

name: build_bit_expansion_tables
description: Builds two lookup tables: the first stores each byte value with every bit doubled into adjacent positions, and the second stores 512 Gray-code derived patterns. It then fills a block of text cells with spaces, using 63 or 50 entries depending on a flag.

name: fill_text_rows_with_spaces
description: Fills a block of text cells with space characters, using 63 or 50 entries depending on a flag. It is the same fill as its neighbour, entered at a later address.

name: fill_text_rows_with_spaces
description: Fills a block of text cells with space characters, using 63 or 50 entries depending on a flag. It is the same fill as the routine just before it.

name: draw_text_list_entries
description: Walks a list of entries, each holding a colour byte, a row and column pair and a zero-terminated string. It copies each string into the text buffer at that position and stores the colour in a parallel buffer 256 bytes further on.

name: render_text_bitplanes_by_row
description: Runs four passes over the text cells, drawing each character into the bitplanes by looking up an 8-byte glyph in the font table, masking it with a colour table, and writing it across four planes with a 40-byte stride. A space clears its cell, and the routine waits on a timer between passes.

name: configure_timing_and_buffers
description: Sets two buffer pointers in the state, then stores timing constants for the current mode. In the first mode it resets the accumulators to zero; otherwise it adds scaled values into them and stores mode-specific constants.

name: draw_text_string_glyphs
description: Draws a zero-terminated string into the bitplanes one character at a time. Each character maps to an 8-byte glyph from the font table, combined with a colour mask and written across four planes with a 40-byte stride, and a space clears its cell.

name: spin_until_timer_count
description: A busy-wait stub that loops with an empty body while comparing a timer counter with a value held in a register. The decompiled exit test does not express cleanly, so it is recorded as a wait on the timer.

name: draw_status_text_glyphs
description: Optionally records a position from state, then either draws the glyphs of a zero-terminated string into the bitplanes or, when another flag is set, shifts a block of stored character codes and redraws six glyph rows stepping 16 units each time.

name: reset_plane_state_and_copy
description: Copies a 32-entry block and a block of about 1840 words of four-plane data, clears a 160-entry region with plane sentinels, and sets default counter constants. It then sets an offset from a table lookup scaled by 2000, clamping a related value to the range minus two to two.

name: draw_indexed_text_string
description: Looks up a zero-terminated string inside a table at an index-based offset and draws its glyphs into the bitplanes with the same per-character glyph logic, where a space clears its cell.

name: run_timed_display_loop
description: Repeatedly updates display state from current records and calls a long series of helpers. It waits until the timer has advanced by five ticks, steps a small wrap-around offset by 8 up to 24, and returns early when a stop flag is set.

name: copy_record_table_into_state
description: Very large routine, truncated in the record. After choosing a source record from state flags, it copies many long and word fields from a table into fixed offsets of a state block, and fills text fields with spaces when no record is selected. The later part is not in the record.

name: overlay_masked_plane_block
description: Overlays a block of seven rows by ten words of four-plane data onto a destination. Where the source fourth plane is set as a mask, the destination's first three planes are ORed with source words, and its fourth plane is cleared under the mask; rows advance by 11 words.

name: draw_inverse_text_glyphs
description: Draws a zero-terminated string into the bitplanes like the plain glyph routine, but combines each glyph with the colour table in a complementary way so characters blend with the existing plane contents. A space leaves its cell unchanged.

name: blit_masked_tile_block
description: Copies an 8-by-8 block of four-plane tile data from a source map into the bitplanes at a computed position. Each byte is combined with mask and colour tables, and source rows advance by per-row offsets.

name: project_visible_objects_to_screen
description: Projects object records to screen coordinates using a 360-step angle table and a distance scale, storing position, size and step values for each visible object. The record is truncated, so the final sorting stage is only partly recovered.

name: draw_sprite_record_chain
description: Walks a chain of sprite records, calling a draw helper for each one and updating a per-record link value. The walk restarts from the first entry when a negative link marks the end of the chain.

name: clip_sprite_to_window
description: Tests a sprite's column and row against a window of 40 columns by 240 rows. If the sprite lies fully outside, it returns a negative code; otherwise it marks edge mask words for partly covered columns and rows and returns the original value.

name: sort_projected_sprites_by_depth
description: Projects object records to screen values as its neighbour does, then runs swap-based passes that reorder the linked entries by a depth field. The record is truncated, so only the projection and first sorting stages are visible.

name: apply_fractional_offset
description: When a byte field is set, computes a fraction of a 16-bit value scaled by 64 minus that byte, stores the fraction, and subtracts it from a companion field.

name: update_sprite_geometry_from_table
description: Recomputes a sprite record's size, position and step values from a table entry indexed by a stored byte, scaling by a divisor. When a flag selects it, the result is copied into the active record, and the routine returns early if the scaled size is too small.

name: update_sprite_by_mode_table
description: Recomputes sprite size, position and step values from a mode-indexed table for records with a visible flag. Two special mode values take a separate path, and the routine returns early when the scaled size is zero.

name: update_sprite_from_fixed_table
description: For records with a specific flag, recomputes size, position and step values from fixed offset tables indexed by a stored mode value, scaled by a divisor. It also limits the overlap of two adjacent entries.

name: render_sprite_chain_queue
description: Walks the sprite chain, drawing records whose position falls below a threshold through a helper, then waits until a pending counter reaches zero before returning.

name: clip_sprite_to_screen_area
description: Tests a sprite against a 102-by-320 area. It returns a negative code when the sprite is fully outside, and otherwise marks edge mask words for partly covered rows and columns, returning the original value.

name: advance_angle_timer_table
description: Counts down a short timer and, when it expires, loads the next entry from a table. It also selects a steering offset from one of two tables based on the sign of the wrapped difference between two angles.

name: clear_rectangle_in_planes
description: Clears a rectangle in the bitplanes by writing zero to three planes and all-ones to the fourth. The block size comes from a table entry chosen by an index, plus a fixed offset.

name: mark_record_after_helper_call
description: Sets up a record pointer and a mode value, calls a helper once, and then marks the record's byte at offset 27 as all-ones.

name: copy_panels_and_update_objects
description: Copies several plane regions from source buffers into working buffers and fills their sentinel areas. It then updates timing values and projects visible object records, but the record is truncated, so the later projection branch is only partly recovered.

name: map_records_to_screen_cells
description: Walks the record chain and, for each record in view, converts its position to a screen cell using scaled coordinate offsets. It stores the cell values and calls helpers to continue.

name: dispatch_position_in_range
description: Checks a position against two small bounding ranges. When it falls inside one, it adds a base offset, selects a handler from a table and calls it through an indirect jump; the record stops at an unimplemented instruction, so the tail is not recovered.

name: setup_blitter_rectangle_copy
description: Programs blitter hardware registers for a three-row block copy: it writes mask words, a control word with the logic-function value, source and destination addresses and row modulo values. It repeats this for four planes spaced 8000 bytes apart, waiting on a helper between them.

name: setup_blitter_rectangle_copy
description: Alternate entry into the blitter setup loop: it writes the same mask, control and address register values for four planes spaced 8000 bytes apart, calling a helper between them.

name: setup_blitter_masked_copy
description: Programs the blitter for the same four-plane block copy as its neighbour, with a different row size and mask values, and waits for the operation to finish through a flag-wait helper.

name: setup_blitter_multi_pass_copy
description: Programs the blitter registers in three passes over the planes, then issues one more pass with a different control word and a size of 256. Each pass writes the mask, control, address and modulo registers, and a flag-wait helper sits between them.

name: disable_then_restore_interrupts
description: Clears two state fields, writes the interrupt enable register with the enable bit clear, waits through two helper calls, then sets the enable bit again and clears a further field.

name: increment_pending_step_counter
description: Adds one to a 16-bit pending step counter held in the state block at a fixed offset.

name: read_controls_and_fill_slot
description: Reads the fire-button and second-button registers and updates a direction value with change detection. When fire is active it fills the first free of eight slots with a position and velocity computed from a table, then marks it in use.

name: fill_slot_and_update_sprites
description: Continues the slot update: fills the first free slot when fire is active, writes two pairs of 16-bit position words into the display buffer, and then writes a set-bit value to a hardware control register. The record is truncated, so the tail is only partly recovered.

name: update_fire_slots_and_sprites
description: Updates the slot list and sprite entries when a flag is set, otherwise it takes the other branch. It fills a free slot from a table, writes position words into the display buffer, and runs a mode-dependent helper.

name: write_slot_sprite_entries
description: Fills the first free slot from a table, writes two pairs of position words into the display buffer, and sets the hardware control register with a set-bit value. It then runs a mode-dependent helper as its neighbour does.

name: test_slot_against_rectangles
description: Checks a slot's position against a table of 20 rectangular ranges. On the first match it records the matching entry and calls a handler, then runs a mode-specific follow-up.

name: fill_slot_and_hit_test
description: Fills the first free slot from a table with position and velocity values, writes display buffer entries, and then tests the slot against a set of rectangular ranges, calling a handler on a match.

name: store_projected_slot_position
description: Computes a scaled position for one slot from an angle-based offset and stores it with a size value. It then decrements the slot counter and runs the common update tail, which dispatches through per-mode table entries.

name: flag_slot_when_idle
description: Sets a state flag to 1 when a stored counter is zero or a table entry is zero, as part of the slot update. Otherwise the flag branch continues with the rest of the update.

name: check_slot_inside_panel
description: Checks whether a slot lies inside a fixed rectangle of screen coordinates and, if it does, points the current record at that slot and sets its mode.

name: select_slot_display_mode
description: Chooses one of several hardware control words for the current slot display mode, stores them in the state, and continues into the common update path.

name: test_slot_box_enable_dma
description: Compares a slot's coordinates with a stored bounding box and, when they overlap, updates the display state and writes the DMA control register.

name: store_pending_slot_arguments
description: Clears a pending flag, calls a helper, and stores the three arguments passed in as the current slot's state values.

name: save_slot_state_arguments
description: Stores the first three arguments into the current state words and returns the fourth as its result. It appears to save a slot's working values before a helper call.

name: save_slot_state_arguments
description: Alternate entry of the argument-saving routine: it stores three arguments into the current state words and returns the fourth argument.

name: save_slot_state_arguments
description: Another entry into the argument-saving routine, which stores three arguments into the current state words after a helper call and returns the fourth.

name: dispatch_slot_handler_by_index
description: Calls a handler chosen by an index from a table, sets a state flag when a counter is non-zero, writes a control value to a hardware register, and then stores three arguments into the current state words.

name: lookup_slot_table_value
description: Looks up a value in the slot table through a pointer and a helper call, returning the result as a 32-bit value. It is entered from a gap-decoded region, so the surrounding logic is only partly recovered.

name: dispatch_mode_handlers_then_save
description: Calls a table-indexed handler once for low modes and twice for higher modes, with an extra call for mode 8, then stores three arguments into the current state words.

name: test_mode_four_slot_rectangle
description: Calls a table handler and, in mode 4, checks the slot's position against a fixed rectangle after setting a control word. When the slot is inside, the state points at it, and three arguments are then stored.

name: reset_or_advance_slot_mode
description: When the input value is 8, resets the slot mode to zero and calls a helper if one is set. Otherwise it writes a control value, calls a helper and increments the mode, then clears a flag and stores three arguments.

name: advance_slot_mode_counter
description: Writes a control value, calls a helper, increments the slot mode, clears a pending flag, and stores three arguments into the current state.

name: update_slot_inside_panel_mode
description: When the slot's counter is below 176, writes a control value and tests the slot against a panel rectangle. Inside it, the state points at the slot and the control words follow a flag before the arguments are stored.

name: update_slot_inside_panel_mode
description: Performs the same panel rectangle test as its neighbour without the counter threshold, pointing the state at the slot when it is inside and choosing control words by a flag.

name: mark_slot_mode_advanced
description: Sets a pending flag, calls a helper, writes a control value, increments the slot mode, and stores three arguments into the state.

name: update_slot_inside_panel_mode
description: Writes a control value and runs the panel rectangle test; inside the rectangle the state points at the slot and control words follow a flag, then the arguments are stored.

name: scan_slots_for_rectangle_hit
description: Writes two control words, then walks a list of slots and stops at the first visible slot whose position falls inside the given rectangle. It then stores three arguments into the state.

name: store_pointer_value_advance_mode
description: Copies a 16-bit value from a pointer into the state, sets a pending flag, increments the slot mode and clears another flag. It then stores three arguments into the state.

name: copy_plane_block_to_buffer
description: Copies an eight-row block of four-plane words from one buffer into a second buffer, 40 bytes per row, with plane spacing of 2000 words, after a helper call.

name: dispatch_by_mode_index_table
description: Returns at once when the input is zero. Otherwise it calls a handler chosen from one of two table entries, with the index values 12 and 24 using the second entry.

name: select_handler_for_index
description: Calls one of two table handlers depending on whether the input is 12 or 24; any other value uses the default handler entry.

name: call_default_slot_handler
description: Calls the default handler from a fixed table entry and returns.

name: call_handler_by_offset
description: Calls a handler at the table offset given in the input register and returns.

name: call_handler_with_slot_offset
description: Looks up a handler and an offset in a state table entry, then calls the handler with the offset added to the base value stored in the state.

name: call_handler_from_pending_entry
description: Calls a handler taken from the pending entry, passing that entry's offset added to a base value.

name: lookup_slot_value_by_index
description: Looks up a value for the current slot through pointer tables and a helper call, returning it as a 32-bit value. The record is large, so its later branches are not fully recovered.

name: copy_text_from_table_entry
description: Entry into a routine that copies character data for a table entry into a text buffer, using offsets taken from a table and a helper call. The record is truncated, so the rest of the copy logic is not recovered.

name: advance_record_frame_index
description: Advances a per-record frame index by the current step, wrapping back to zero when it passes the top value. It then scans the slot list and writes the frame value into the matching record, and selects a pattern pointer from one of two tables.

name: advance_record_frame_index
description: Alternate entry of the frame update, which advances the frame index with the same wrap and writes it into the matching record found by scanning the slot list.

name: toggle_record_flag_and_scan
description: Toggles a flag byte on a record and scans the slot list, writing the returned value into the matching record. It then selects one of two pattern pointers by that flag and writes a short fixed byte pattern.

name: pulse_helper_twenty_times
description: Temporarily clears a state flag, calls a helper twenty times in a loop, then restores the flag and calls another helper.

name: forward_three_helper_calls
description: Calls three helper routines in order and returns the value passed on the stack. It adds no logic of its own.

name: forward_two_helper_calls
description: Calls two helper routines in order and returns the value passed on the stack. It adds no logic of its own.

name: forward_one_helper_call
description: Calls one helper routine and returns the value passed on the stack. It adds no logic of its own.

name: forward_one_helper_call
description: Calls one helper routine and returns the value passed on the stack. It adds no logic of its own.

name: forward_one_helper_call
description: Calls one helper routine and returns the value passed on the stack. It adds no logic of its own.

name: forward_one_helper_call
description: Calls one helper routine and returns the value passed on the stack. It adds no logic of its own.

name: forward_helper_return_pair
description: Calls one helper routine and returns the pair of 32-bit values held in the data registers.

name: swap_field_around_helper
description: Saves a 32-bit state field, replaces it with a value passed in, calls a helper, then restores the saved value.

name: call_handler_indexed_word
description: Calls a handler from a table using a word index that is multiplied by four. It has no other logic.

name: format_state_text_field
description: Builds a text field from state data by copying characters through helper calls and returns a 16-bit position value. The record is large, and its later branches are not all recovered.

name: build_text_field_from_pointer
description: Builds a text field from data reached through a pointer, copying characters with helper calls and returning a 16-bit length value. The record is large, so the tail is only partly recovered.

name: write_text_field_prefix
description: Sets a text pointer into the status buffer and writes a short sequence of characters up to a fixed end marker.

name: write_label_after_helper_call
description: Calls a helper and then writes a short run of character codes into the text buffer that the helper has prepared.

name: measure_text_length
description: Counts the characters of a zero-terminated text up to the terminator, then uses that length to set a text buffer position.

name: select_text_label_by_index
description: Chooses a text label from a table and copies it into the text buffer, returning a short value from the copy.

name: write_stop_label
description: Writes the STOP label into a text buffer through helper calls and returns a short value for the position used.

name: write_full_label
description: Writes the FULL label into a text buffer, using a value passed in to choose the row, and returns.

name: write_marker_character
description: Calls a helper and then writes an exclamation mark into the text buffer at the position the helper prepared.

name: format_numeric_text_field
description: Formats a numeric value into a text field through helper calls and returns a short position value.

name: clear_text_marker
description: Calls a helper and then clears the marker byte at the text position it prepared.

name: format_text_field_with_length
description: Builds a text field by copying characters through helper calls and returns a short position value. The record is large, so only part of its logic is recovered.

name: write_text_field_variant
description: Writes a text field through helper calls, using a different text source from its neighbour, and returns a short value.

name: return_short_after_helper
description: Calls one helper while writing a text field, then returns a short value.

name: format_text_field_alt_entry
description: Alternate entry into the text field routine: it builds a text field through helper calls and returns a short position value.

name: process_table_entries_until_end
description: Walks table entries by an offset, copying fields from each entry into the state until an end marker. The record contains unimplemented instructions, so the tail is not recovered.

name: copy_text_cells_with_offset
description: Copies character cells between text positions using a computed offset, moving runs of bytes and words within the text buffer.

name: copy_text_row_cells
description: Copies a few words and bytes between two rows of the text buffer, using offsets from the caller.

name: write_number_decimal_digits
description: Writes a 16-bit value as ASCII decimal digits, hundreds first, and leaves out any leading digit that is zero.

name: write_compact_decimal_value
description: Writes a value as one or two decimal digit characters, adding a tens digit only when the value is 10 or more, then the units digit.

name: copy_text_label_entry
description: Copies a text label from a table into the text buffer through helper calls. The record is truncated, so the closing steps are not recovered.

name: write_indexed_text_entry
description: Writes a text entry chosen by a register index into the text buffer through helper calls. The record is truncated, so the later part is not recovered.

name: fill_text_row_remainder
description: Fills the rest of a text row by counting down from sixteen minus a width value and writing characters until the row is full.

name: copy_word_pairs_until_end
description: Walks a byte-coded list and copies word pairs into an output list, stopping at an end marker.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: A stub that only returns, with no work done.

name: update_cell_and_mask_columns
description: Entry into a routine that converts record positions to cells by dividing by 6000, compares them with the last cell, and when they change refreshes the column mask table and redraws affected column lines.

name: update_cell_and_mask_columns
description: Alternate entry into the same cell update routine, which divides positions by 6000 and refreshes the column mask table when the cell changes.

name: update_cell_and_mask_columns
description: Another entry into the cell update routine that converts a position to a cell, compares it with the previous cell and refreshes the column masks on change.

name: update_cell_and_mask_columns
description: Converts a record's position into a cell by dividing by 6000. When the cell changes, it resets a column mask table and redraws column lines into the planes; the record is truncated.

name: fill_handler_grid
description: Fills a grid of fifteen by fifteen entries with a handler pointer, starting from an offset held in the state.

name: fill_handler_grid_with_checks
description: Fills the same fifteen-by-fifteen grid as its neighbour, with extra checks on each cell before the handler pointer is stored.

name: draw_column_fill_lines
description: Draws vertical fill lines into the planes for each column that has a valid start, writing a fill value upward with a 40-byte stride, and returns a short result.

name: mark_visible_edges
description: Walks an edge list of three endpoint pairs and marks a slot as visible when the endpoints fall inside the clip area. Valid pairs are passed to the clipping routine.

name: order_pair_and_test_flags
description: Orders two coordinate values, then checks flag table entries at both ends to decide whether the edge is visible, returning a 32-bit value.

name: clip_edge_to_window
description: Clips a line edge against a window by computing the intercept from halved deltas and storing the clipped endpoints. It returns a short result.

name: order_pair_and_call_helper
description: Orders two 16-bit values so the smaller comes first, then calls a helper and returns both values packed into one result.

name: update_table_with_interrupts_off
description: Disables an interrupt source through the interrupt enable register, updates a table of entries with computed values through helper calls, then restores the enable bit.

name: poll_joystick_buttons_state
description: Reads the joystick fire-button port and the potentiometer register, updating button state variables and returning a 32-bit value. The record is truncated.

name: setup_display_dma_and_planes
description: Writes the DMA control register and programs the display plane pointers for the playfield, calling helpers at each step. The record is truncated, so the later steps are not recovered.

name: return_stack_value_after_calls
description: Calls two helper routines and returns the value passed on the stack unchanged.

name: return_stack_value_after_calls
description: Calls helper routines and returns the value passed on the stack unchanged.

name: toggle_interrupt_and_update_state
description: Writes the interrupt enable register to disable a source, updates a state table through helper calls, then re-enables it and returns the stack value.

name: update_state_table_entry
description: Looks up an entry in a state table using a 16-bit index, updates its fields through helper calls, and returns.

name: load_table_pair_into_state
description: Loads a pair of 32-bit values from a table entry chosen by an index into fixed state fields, then calls a helper.

name: copy_word_block_between_pointers
description: Copies a block of 32-bit words between buffers selected by pointers. The record is truncated, so the later branches are not recovered.

name: copy_masked_word_rows
description: Entry into a routine that writes 16-bit words into a row buffer, shaped by a byte selector and a width value. The record is truncated.

name: copy_masked_word_rows
description: Alternate entry into the same word row routine, which starts at a different point in the row buffer.

name: copy_masked_word_rows
description: Entry into the word row routine with a different selector, writing 16-bit words into a row buffer. The record is truncated.

name: copy_masked_word_rows
description: Word row routine entry that calls a helper and writes words into the row buffer; the record is truncated.

name: fill_empty_entries_with_value
description: Walks sixteen entries spaced 96 bytes apart and sets each entry's empty field to a supplied value when that field is zero.

name: forward_state_pair_to_helper
description: Reads a pair of 16-bit state fields and a table reference, calls a helper with them, and returns two 32-bit values.

name: scan_masked_linked_entries
description: Walks a linked list of entries, testing each entry's flag word against masks, and returns the stack value. The record is truncated.

name: scan_masked_linked_entries
description: Alternate entry of the masked list scan, stepping through the list with a different link offset.

name: setup_blitter_copy_registers
description: Writes mask words, a control word, and address and modulo values to the blitter registers from state fields, then calls a helper. The record is truncated.

name: setup_blitter_source_registers
description: Writes mask words, control words, and source address and modulo registers for the blitter from state values, then returns.

name: write_column_blit_control
description: For a column index within the range minus fifteen to 319, computes a control word from the index shifted into the top bits, combines it with a fixed logic value, and writes it to the blitter control register.

name: write_column_blit_control
description: Alternate entry of the column control routine, which computes and writes the same blitter control word for an in-range column index.

name: write_column_blit_control
description: Alternate entry that computes the column control word for an in-range column and stores it in a shadow location instead of the blitter register.

name: write_column_blit_control
description: Writes the column control word to the blitter control register for an in-range column index; a neighbouring entry does the same computation.

name: write_column_blit_control
description: Entry into the column control routine that computes the blitter control word for an in-range column index.

name: setup_blitter_column_copy
description: Programs the blitter registers for copying one column of tiles, setting mask words, modulo, address and control values. It shares its entry with the column control routine, and the record is truncated.

name: setup_blitter_four_pass_fill
description: Runs a four-pass loop that writes constant values and all-ones masks into a table, calling helpers between passes, after setting a base pointer from the state.

name: set_row_pointer_from_state
description: Computes a buffer pointer from a state value, offset by a fixed amount and scaled by 40, then writes fixed constants and calls two helpers.

name: draw_row_block_fixed_offsets
description: Sets a buffer pointer at a fixed offset from the state, writes fixed constants, and runs a four-pass loop that calls a helper on each pass.

name: draw_row_block_second_layout
description: Writes a second set of pointer offsets and constants into the shadow registers, then calls helpers three times in sequence.

name: set_row_pointer_from_slot
description: Computes a buffer pointer from a slot value scaled by 40 and writes fixed constants, then calls a helper and repeats with a second pointer.

name: setup_blitter_four_pass_copy
description: Runs a four-pass loop that writes the blitter mask words, control word and address registers, calling a helper between passes.
